mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDP decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained high rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained payroll declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for four consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained industrial production declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
